# cubepath_dns_record (Resource)

Manages a DNS record on CubePath Cloud.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Record content/value.
- `name` (String) Record name (e.g., '@' for root, 'www', 'mail').
- `type` (String) Record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, CAA).
- `zone_uuid` (String) The UUID of the DNS zone.

### Optional

- `priority` (Number) Record priority (for MX, SRV records).
- `ttl` (Number) Time to live in seconds. Defaults to 3600.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The UUID of the DNS record.
